name: Carbonaceous
description: A carbonaceous asteroid, commonly found in moderate quantities, with a standard extraction and refining rate. It has average capacity and resistance, making it a reliable resource.

name: Metallic
description: A metallic asteroid, commonly found in large quantities, with a slow extraction and refining rate. It has a high capacity and strong resistance, making it a durable resource.

name: Silicaceous
description: A silicaceous asteroid, commonly found in rare quantities, with a high extraction and refining rate. It has high capacity and resistance, making it a valuable resource.

name: Uranian
description: A uranian asteroid, commonly found inside nebulau, with a very high extraction and refining rate. It has very low capacity and resistance, making it a special resource.

name: Wreck
description: Resource derived from the destruction of objects or enemy ships, featuring a very high extraction and refining rate.
